jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
jobs.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What We Do

Go To Market Engineering builds the internal products and AI systems that make our sellers, traders, and account teams faster and sharper — from sprint and pipeline dashboards to agentic assistants that prep a rep before a call or flag a deal at risk before it slips. We sit at the intersection of engineering, data, and revenue strategy, shipping tools that directly move the needle on revenue growth and sales productivity.

What you’ll do:

Architect and build agentic systems that automate and augment GTM workflows — pipeline hygiene, account research, call prep, deal risk scoring, forecasting, and rep coaching — using LLM orchestration frameworks( Ex: LangGraph ).
Define the agentic platform strategy for the pod: agent design patterns, tool-calling conventions, retrieval-augmented pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop guardrails for revenue-critical workflows.
Integrate core GTM systems (Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Slack, and The Trade Desk's own platform data) as agent-accessible tools and data sources via internal data platforms and MCP-style interfaces.
Set the technical bar for the pod — reviewing designs, establishing engineering standards, and leading architectural reviews across the GTM Engineering roadmap.
Partner directly with Product, Sales, Trading, and RevOps leadership to translate agentic capability into measurable outcomes — pipeline velocity, forecast accuracy, rep ramp time, and sales productivity — and mentor engineers in the pod on AI-first thinking.

Who you are:

BS degree in Engineering related discipline and 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building production LLM or agentic applications (agents, RAG pipelines, tool-use, multi-agent orchestration).
Deep fluency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with hands-on experience in agentic frameworks — LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar.
Strong command of enterprise integration patterns: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architecture, and connecting SaaS GTM platforms (CRM, sales engagement, data enrichment) programmatically.
Experience building full-stack applications end to end — from data pipelines and backend services to the front-end tools sellers and traders actually use daily.
Track record as a technical lead: driving architectural decisions, writing RFCs, and raising the quality bar across a team without relying on management authority.

Nice to have:

Prior experience in Sales/RevOps tooling, GTM engineering, or internal tooling domains — especially in ad tech, media, or programmatic advertising.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, Gainsight, or similar GTM platforms — especially via API or integration layer.
Experience evaluating and red-teaming LLM agents for safety, reliability, and correctness in revenue-critical business contexts.
Exposure to media buying, campaign performance data, or advertising analytics.

The Trade Desk does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of The Trade Desk. The Trade Desk is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

In accordance with various US state laws, the range provided is the Trade Desk's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, and location. All employees may be eligible to become The Trade Desk shareholders through eligibility for stock-based compensation grants, which are awarded to employees based on company and individual performance. The Trade Desk also offers other compensation depending on the role such as variable compensation-based incentives and commissions. Plus, expected benefits for this role include comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents, retirement benefits such as a 401k plan and company match, short and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, well-being benefits, reimbursement for certain tuition expenses, parental leave, sick time of 1 hour per 30 hours worked, vacation time for full-time employees up to 120 hours thru the first year and 160 hours thereafter, and around 13 paid holidays per year. Employees can also purchase The Trade Desk stock at a discount through The Trade Desk’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

$124,900—$228,900 USD

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building Systems Integration Agent, announced at Dreamforce, which learns how to operate enterprise applications and turns complex workflows into reusable, code-backed automation. Customers are already running workflows in production; now we’re making that success repeatable across more systems and use cases.

Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?

You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. As a Principal Engineer, you’ll remain hands-on while shaping architecture across our agent and backend systems, owning critical capabilities from design through operation, and helping other engineers deliver them.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive Agent Development & Architecture

Design and build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.
Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.
Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.
Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers

Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.
Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.
Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.
Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team

Lead architectural decisions across agent execution, backend services, and workflow state, aligning system boundaries and tradeoffs with other technical leads.
Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.
Raise the engineering bar through hands-on implementation, design reviews, and mentoring; help engineers take on broader ownership and participate in hiring.

You're Our Person If...

You’ve led the architecture and delivery of complex backend systems through deployment, production failures, and subsequent improvements, with impact across multiple components or teams.
You have hands-on experience shipping and operating LLM-powered systems, and can explain how evaluations and production failures informed your design decisions.
You can reason through concurrency, persistent state, retries, and partial failures in systems that perform consequential actions.
You’re proficient in Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
You can turn an unclear customer problem into a bounded technical approach, test it with users, and lead it through production while creating capabilities other engineers can build on.
You want direct customer engagement to be part of your engineering work, including investigating problems and discussing technical tradeoffs.
You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship.

Even Better If…

Agent tool use, code generation, automated recovery, or evaluation frameworks.
Browser automation, workflow orchestration, or enterprise integrations.
Building an early-stage product or working in a customer-facing engineering role.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building Systems Integration Agent, announced at Dreamforce, which learns how to operate enterprise applications and turns complex workflows into reusable, code-backed automation. Customers are already running workflows in production; now we’re making that success repeatable across more systems and use cases.

Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?

You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. As a Principal Engineer, you’ll remain hands-on while shaping architecture across our agent and backend systems, owning critical capabilities from design through operation, and helping other engineers deliver them.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive Agent Development & Architecture

Design and build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.
Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.
Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.
Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers

Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.
Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.
Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.
Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team

Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.
Raise the engineering bar through hands-on implementation, design reviews, and mentoring; help engineers take on broader ownership and participate in hiring.

You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship.

Agent tool use, code generation, automated recovery, or evaluation frameworks.

jobs.description:
About Us

GMI Cloud is the AI-native inference cloud, built for production AI. Backed by Headline VC and one of only seven cloud providers worldwide designated an NVIDIA Reference Platform Cloud Partner, we run NVIDIA H100, H200, B300, GB300, Vera Rubin GPUs in our own data centers, with GPU regions across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
We own the full stack end to end: inference APIs and Model-as-a-Service on top, a Kubernetes-based orchestration layer with autoscaling, load balancing, and multi-region deployment in the middle, and dedicated and on-demand GPU compute on owned hardware underneath.

About This Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure & Distributed Systems to build the infrastructure that runs GMI’s global inference engine and Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) platform. You will own the systems layer underneath every AI request we serve: the Kubernetes platform, GPU fleet orchestration, traffic routing, observability, and the high-concurrency services that tie them together.
This role is for engineers who think in systems, not components. You will design and operate cloud-native, multi-region platforms that handle bursty, latency-sensitive AI workloads at production scale, and you will make them reliable, efficient, and observable.
We are not just running clusters. We are building the operating system for AI inference at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform that runs GMI’s dedicated inference and MaaS across multiple GPU clusters in the U.S. and Asia.
Architect high-concurrency, low-latency distributed services — API gateways, request routing, load balancing, rate limiting, and queueing — that stay correct and degrade gracefully under extreme load.
Build multi-cluster and multi-region traffic management, including failover, capacity-aware scheduling, and global load distribution across heterogeneous GPU fleets.
Own GPU resource orchestration on Kubernetes: scheduling, autoscaling, bin-packing, node lifecycle, and health management to maximize utilization and minimize cost per token.
Develop operators, controllers, and automation (CRDs, GitOps/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code) that make deployments repeatable, safe, and fast.
Build the observability foundation — metrics, tracing, logging, and alerting — and drive SLOs, incident response, and post-incident improvements.
Drive system-level performance work across concurrency control, the request lifecycle, networking, storage, and compute coordination.
Set engineering standards for reliability, correctness, and long-term maintainability in a fast-moving AI ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of backend or infrastructure engineering, with deep expertise in distributed system design.
Proven experience building and operating high-concurrency, large-scale distributed systems in production.
Strong, hands-on Kubernetes experience in production: workloads, networking, storage, scheduling, autoscaling, and debugging cluster-level issues. Experience writing operators or controllers is a strong plus.
Solid cloud infrastructure fundamentals: Linux, networking (L4/L7 load balancing, DNS, service mesh), containers, and at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) or bare-metal data center environment.
Strong understanding of system design tradeoffs across scalability, consistency, availability, and performance.
Proficiency in Go and/or Python; familiarity with C++ or Rust is a plus.
Familiarity with distributed system patterns such as load balancing, rate limiting, queueing, caching, and multi-region deployment.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, or similar).
Strong debugging, profiling, and performance optimization skills, and clear communication about complex systems end to end.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LLM inference systems or serving frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, or similar), including deploying and scaling them on Kubernetes.
Experience building or operating a Model-as-a-Service platform, inference API, or other developer-facing AI API at scale (e.g., OpenAI-compatible endpoints, usage metering, multi-tenant isolation).
Experience serving multimodal workloads — image, video, audio, or vision-language models — and their distinct latency, memory, and throughput profiles.
Familiarity with GPU infrastructure: NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG, InfiniBand/RDMA, NCCL, or large-scale GPU cluster operations.
Knowledge of inference-specific optimizations such as KV-cache-aware routing, prefill/decode disaggregation, continuous batching, or speculative decoding.
Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and real-time data or streaming systems (Kafka or similar).

Why Join GMI Cloud

Work on real production AI infrastructure: our own GPU clusters, real customers, real traffic — not a sandbox.
High ownership and direct impact: a small, senior team where your designs ship and define how the platform evolves.
Close partnership with NVIDIA and early access to the latest GPU platforms and inference technologies.
A seat at the frontier of AI infrastructure, shaping how models are served globally.

The Intel GPU Compiler Team develops the compiler technologies that unlock the performance, scalability, and efficiency of Intel's next-generation graphics and accelerated computing platforms. As a GPU Compiler Software Engineer,

You will play a key role in translating innovative hardware features into high-performance software solutions and helping shape the future of Intel's graphics and accelerated computing roadmap.

This position offers the opportunity to work across the hardware and software stack, influence next-generation GPU architecture, and solve some of the industry's most challenging compiler optimization problems.

The Data Center Group (DCG) develops leading-edge computing, networking, and acceleration technologies that power modern cloud infrastructure and data centers worldwide. jobs.title: Process Automation Engineer-Packaging
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Responsibilities

As the Process Automation Engineer – Packaging,
you will be supporting and managing the Packaging lines crucial to Lilly's supply chain. This role will be part of the RTP Site

Engineering organization responsible for the packaging lines and support of continuous operations by providing subject matter expertise in process control, improvements, project management, and technical leadership to the process Automation team.

Key Objectives/Deliverables

Ultimately responsible for the qualified state of the Packaging lines throughout its entire lifecycle.
Owner/SME of equipment, Packaging processes, and maintenance programs associated with Lilly Global Quality Standards (GQS) and Engineering Best Practices/Functional Standards (EBP/EFS).
Technically lead and delegate activities to a cross-functional technical team supporting the assembly lines on medium-large scale projects.
Proficient and capable of understanding OSHA/regulatory (CFR) requirements and ensuring compliance.
Ensure a safe working environment by following safety rules and helping improve the safety culture.
Take overall responsibility for the safe design and safe operation of the equipment within the area.
Mentor and coach process and automation Packaging engineers on first principles and Lilly processes.
Communicate effectively as a technical leader with cross functional team members in roles such as quality, logistics, and crafts personnel.
Clear understanding of equipment flow chart, process flow document, critical quality attributes, and equipment controls.
Establish control charts & monitor/trend operating parameters to verify and optimize equipment performance/KPIs.
Provide support in troubleshooting efforts to resolve more difficult equipment and operational problems.
Utilize formal problem-solving techniques, such as root cause analysis and causal factor charting, to resolve equipment deviations.
Provide rotational on-call support for 24-hour operations.
Responsible for system/component classification and maintenance strategy for equipment.
Identify and gain alignment on corrective actions and countermeasures arising from CAPA’s.
Accountable for Periodic Reviews for equipment.
Lead in qualification activities (including commissioning activities of new equipment or areas).
Act as main point of contact for capital projects or local projects.
Identify and drive improvement opportunities (procedural changes, upgrades, projects, etc.) associated with equipment within the area.
Compare equipment performance data with other manufacturing sites within the network to determine areas of opportunity.
Goals/objectives should target world-class levels of operation for safety, quality and customer service.

Requirements (Education, Experience, Training)

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
7+ years of experience in a process engineer or automation engineer role
Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1

Preferred Attributes But Not Required

Ability to lead first-time processes and navigating a cross-functional team through ambiguity.
Pharmaceutical cGMP experience and compliance OSHA and CFR knowledge.
Project management skills.
Adequate interpersonal and communications skills to be able to work effectively in a team-based environment.
Strong computer skills in a variety of software packages (e.g., Excel, JMP, etc.).
Ability to work in a safe manner to ensure the safety of self and others.
Adept knowledge of discrete manufacturing.
Strong knowledge of Studio 5000 and Factory talk view SE.
Understanding of automated vision systems, and robotics.
Ability to trouble shoot PLC and HMI programming.
Responsible for maintaining a safe work environment, working safely and accountable for supporting all HSE Corporate and Site Goals.
Ability to apply statistical thinking concepts to the analysis of manufacturing problems.
Experience working with validated systems.
Experience in utilizing root cause analysis techniques for the systematic solving of problems.

Additional Information

Schedule - Monday through Friday, rotational on-call support will be required.
Travel - Domestic and International travel may be required (~5-10%)

Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

$67,500 - $173,800

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #177430 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a caring, innovative growth company that is reimagining a healthier future for all people, their pets and our planet. Focused on Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care and Pet Nutrition, we sell our products in more than 200 countries and territories under brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, elmex, hello, meridol, Sorriso, Tom’s of Maine, EltaMD, Filorga, Irish Spring, PCA SKIN, Protex, Sanex, Softsoap, Speed Stick, Ajax, Axion, Fabuloso, Soupline and Suavitel, as well as Hill’s Pet Nutrition.

As a Data Engineer
, you will focus on developing data pipelines for multi-functional teams, ultimately empowering the organization to make more data-driven decisions. You will be responsible for building data pipelines from source to consumption layer, following the medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold). Leveraging a technology stack that includes Snowflake, dbt, Python, and SQL, you will assemble large, sophisticated data sets that meet functional and non-functional business requirements. Working with various stakeholders, you will gather requirements and deliver compliant, efficient, sustainable, and well-documented solutions.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Development and Architecture
End-to-End Execution: Build, support, and maintain data pipelines from source to consumption layers using Snowflake, dbt, Python, and SQL.
Architecture Strategy: Implement the medallion architecture to ensure organized data progression and quality.
Data Assembly: Assemble large, sophisticated data sets that meet functional and non-functional business requirements.
Standard Stack: Leverage the standard data engineering technology stack to deliver data pipelines that are compliant with enterprise standards and best practices.
Process Optimization and Innovation
Continuous Improvement: Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, including automating manual processes and optimizing data delivery.
Emerging Tech: Research and evaluate new and emerging technologies within the data engineering space.
Collaboration and Support
Stakeholder Engagement: Work with various stakeholders across the company to gather requirements.
Technical Assistance: Assist with data-related technical issues and support data infrastructure needs.

Organizations today depend on high-quality, trusted data to drive mission-critical decisions. As data volumes continue to grow across structured and semi-structured sources, organizations need scalable data engineering solutions that transform complex datasets into reliable, actionable insights.

As a data engineer at Booz Allen, you'll help design, build, and maintain modern data pipelines and analytical workflows that support enterprise reporting, reconciliation, compliance, and decision-making. You'll work with large-scale Department of Defense (DoD) data environments, leveraging cloud technologies and distributed computing platforms to automate ingestion, enforce data quality controls, and integrate data from multiple sources into governed data products.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams of data engineers, analysts, developers, and mission stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions. Using technologies such as Databricks, Python, Spark, SQL, and modern cloud-based platforms, you'll develop and optimize end-to-end data pipelines, troubleshoot processing issues, validate data integrity, and deliver analytical products that enable enterprise-wide insights. Here, you'll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where you'll help modernize data ecosystems, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making across complex mission spaces.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have: 

3+ years of experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ETL or ELT processes, or data engineering solutions
Experience using Python and SQL for data integration, transformation, and analytics
Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, or distributed data processing frameworks
Experience developing and optimizing end-to-end data pipelines with data quality controls, validation frameworks, or anomaly detection processes

Secret clearance

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Lead the Way to Intelligent Banking with Us!

You might not think about what happens behind the scenes when you check your bank balance or deposit a check from your phone, but we do. Every day.

Kinective empowers banks and credit unions to move beyond keeping up with technology to shaping the future of banking. Our platform seamlessly connects the right tools, delivers real-time data, and drives smarter operations for more than 4,000 financial institutions nationwide. We are a fast-growing team built on individual ownership, company-wide collaboration, and setting industry-leading standards. Here, new ideas are encouraged, candid feedback is welcomed, and your growth truly matters as much as the company’s. At Kinective, we are leading the way to intelligent banking together and enjoying the journey along the way.

Why This Role Matters

As a Manual Test & Automation Engineer at Kinective, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our products are reliable, scalable, and ready for real-world banking environments. You’ll own quality engineering for assigned product areas while contributing to both hands-on manual testing and automation efforts, helping strengthen release confidence, AI-assisted testing, and technical quality practices across the Data Intelligence platform.

This role goes beyond test execution—you’ll translate requirements into thoughtful test strategies, perform manual testing as needed, build maintainable UI and API automation, design and govern AI-assisted QA workflows, improve framework and pipeline health, make risk visible, and partner with Product and Engineering to deliver with confidence. If you enjoy digging into complex problems, improving how things work, and building software customers can trust, you’ll thrive here. You'll work primarily in a data-heavy enterprise platform with a mature, component-framework-based UI — dynamic grids, embedded frames, and heavy asynchronous loading. Building automation that stays stable against it is genuinely challenging work, and genuinely valuable when it's done well.

What You’ll Own

Test Strategy & Planning

Own risk-based test strategy for assigned product areas, translating requirements and acceptance criteria into clear, testable outcomes.
Drive coverage planning across scenarios, test data, environments, and release risks in partnership with QA, Product, and Engineering.
Use AI-assisted story analysis to accelerate test design while ensuring human review, traceability, and quality standards.

Test Execution & Automation

Perform manual functional, regression, exploratory, and scenario-based testing as needed to validate product quality and release readiness.
Own reliable UI and API automation for critical workflows using Playwright, TypeScript, and maintainable test patterns.
Run and report release-scoped regression, producing clear readiness evidence and a documented view of coverage gaps before a release.
Build reusable page objects, components, utilities, fixtures, test data, assertions, and diagnostics that improve speed and trust.
Apply AI-assisted tools to generate, extend, debug, and maintain tests while validating correctness, security, determinism, and release relevance.
Manage test environments and test data, including provisioning and refreshing environments, loading and validating datasets, and troubleshooting remote access and connectivity issues.

Defect Management & Troubleshooting

Triage the scheduled regression run on a daily cadence, classifying each failure by disposition — product defect, test defect, environment issue, or inconclusive — and driving each to a resolution or an owner.
Own clear defect identification, documentation, triage, and prioritization in Jira through resolution.
Diagnose root causes across application, test, data, environment, and infrastructure issues using evidence-driven analysis.
Turn escaped defects and production incidents into durable regression coverage or a documented improvement plan.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Own quality visibility across the SDLC by surfacing regression trends, flaky-test patterns, framework health, CI/CD feedback, and release evidence.
Maintain QA documentation, test cases, and knowledge-sharing resources.
Own Jira/Xray test-management upkeep on a per-story basis: creating Test issues, linking Test Executions back to Stories, and keeping automation-to-test-key mappings current so traceability stays intact.
Use and maintain the team's AI-assisted QA workflows, applying judgment about when generated output can be trusted and when it needs rework.
Partner across teams, review test code, mentor others, and raise quality standards through shared ownership and practical improvements.

How We’ll Measure Success

High-quality releases with reliable evidence and minimal critical defects reaching production.
Strong risk-based coverage, including effective automation that improves speed, confidence, and repeatability.
Efficient defect resolution and a trustworthy regression suite, with clear documentation, root-cause identification, stable pass rates, a shrinking backlog of non-actionable failures, and results the team acts on rather than works around.
AI-assisted QA workflows improve speed and coverage while producing standards-compliant, maintainable, reviewable, and traceable outputs.
Early detection of issues through stronger requirements, testability, collaboration, and feedback loops.
Ongoing improvements to QA processes, framework health, pipeline feedback, and release readiness.
Effective collaboration and mentoring, with growth toward broader QA leadership responsibilities over time.

Success here isn’t about checking boxes – it’s about propelling Kinective’s mission to lead the way to intelligent banking. You must bring excellence to your craft, balance resourcefulness with respect, share and celebrate unique expertise and diverse perspectives, and continuously raise the bar as we innovate and grow.

Necessary Qualifications & Competencies

4+ years in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, manual testing, automation engineering, or a similar role.
2+ years designing and maintaining test automation for UI, API, and regression coverage.
Practical experience using AI-assisted tools in QA or software engineering workflows, including test design, code generation, debugging, failure analysis, or documentation.
Experience working as a senior individual contributor, technical owner, or mentor in a quality engineering team.

Technical Skills

Hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript or a comparable modern browser-automation framework.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs for correctness, maintainability, traceability, security, deterministic behavior, and fit-for-purpose coverage.
Experience with API testing tools such as REST Assured, Postman, or similar.
Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, GitLab, pull requests, code review, CI/CD pipelines, Jira, Xray, and system integrations.

Process & Tools

Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile delivery, risk-based testing, and shift-left quality practices.
Ability to design maintainable automation using page objects, reusable components, stable locators, meaningful assertions, and useful diagnostics.
Ability to analyze logs, traces, screenshots, AI-generated explanations, and test artifacts to identify root cause and improve test signal.

Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and sound judgment when using AI-generated recommendations.
Clear documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain AI-assisted QA decisions and tradeoffs.
Self-motivated, adaptable, collaborative, and comfortable influencing responsible AI adoption without formal authority.

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with Selenium/WebDriver and Java-based legacy automation is a plus, but not required.
Experience testing complex single-page applications, dynamic component libraries, or data-heavy enterprise systems.
Experience with enterprise CI/CD and DevOps platforms, containerized test execution, debugging and trace analysis, test reporting, and quality engineering dashboards.
Experience evaluating AI-enabled product behavior, LLM-based features, confidence thresholds, model outputs, or human-review workflows.
Experience testing data integrity, permissions, security boundaries, reporting, synchronization, or AI-enabled product behavior.
Experience designing or operating AI-assisted or agentic QA workflows that connect requirements, test generation, execution, failure analysis, and test-management updates.
Familiarity with financial services data — banking or credit union systems, core integrations, or regulated reporting.

Pay, Benefits & Total Rewards

$60,000–$80,000 with 10% bonus potential

The salary range listed reflects the minimum and maximum for this role. Individual compensation is based on experience, qualifications, job-related skills, location, and internal equity, and most offers are not made at the top of the range.

Benefits

Base pay is one part of Kinective’s Total Rewards package. Depending on the role, employees may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. All employees have access to a competitive benefits package designed to support health, well-being, and financial security, including:

Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, prescriptions, life & disability)
Flexible PTO, 11 company holidays, and generous parental and caregiver leave
An immediately vested 401(k) with company contributions
Wellness resources and professional development opportunities

If you’ve made it this far, we’d love to hear from you. Click Apply

.

jobs.title: Wireless Software Engineer (5G/6G Protocol Stack)
jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.

Responsibilities

About the Role

Keysight is seeking a highly skilled Wireless Software Engineer with deep wireless protocol expertise to join our Forward Deployment Engineer team. The individual will work at the forefront of 5G-Advanced and next-generation wireless technologies. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex protocol challenges, developing production-quality software, and collaborating directly with leading wireless technology companies.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams and Keysight R&D to develop, customize, integrate, and optimize software solutions used in the development of next-generation wireless systems. Unlike traditional support or deployment roles, you will actively contribute code, debug protocol stack behavior, build software features, and drive technical solutions that influence both customer products and Keysight technology roadmaps.

This is a highly development-focused role requiring strong software engineering expertise and deep knowledge of 3GPP wireless protocols. Successful candidates will be comfortable investigating issues across multiple protocol layers, performing root-cause analysis, modifying production code, and developing software enhancements that directly address customer and product requirements. You will have the opportunity to influence both customer solutions and future Keysight product capabilities by translating field challenges into product enhancements, software innovations, and new technical approaches.

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and enhance software features within wireless communication systems and protocol stacks.
Develop production-quality software in C/C++ and Python for Linux-based environments.
Analyze and debug complex issues across Layer 1 (PHY), Layer 2 (MAC/RLC/PDCP), and Layer 3 (RRC/NAS) protocols.
Investigate and troubleshoot issues across the full protocol stack, including areas outside your primary domain expertise, collaborating with development teams to drive root-cause resolution.
Diagnose and resolve complex issues encountered during customer deployments, integrations, and performance optimization activities.
Modify existing software and develop new code to address customer-specific requirements and technical challenges.
Develop APIs, software tools, automation frameworks, and diagnostics that improve development productivity and system visibility.
Analyze signaling logs, traces, packet captures, performance metrics, and timing behavior to identify root causes of system issues.
Build prototypes and rapidly validate new features and protocol enhancements.
Enhance existing Keysight software through feature development, performance improvements, and customer-driven innovations.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to software quality, maintainability, and engineering best practices.
Develop a deep understanding of Keysight software architecture, feature implementation, and protocol stack behavior to effectively diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
Collaborate closely with Keysight R&D teams to translate field findings into product improvements, software enhancements, and new capabilities.
Lead technical discussions with customers and provide guidance on protocol implementation, system architecture, and performance optimization.
Contribute to software releases, validation activities, and deployment of new features into customer development environments.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
6 to 7 years of experience in software development for wireless communication systems.
Strong software development experience in C/C++ and Python.
Experience developing software in Linux environments.
Solid understanding of 4G LTE, 5G NR, or 5G-Advanced technologies.
Deep understanding of 3GPP protocols across Layers 1-3, particularly RRC and NAS.
Hands-on software development experience within one or more wireless protocol stack layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, or NAS.
Proven experience as an R&D, platform, systems, or protocol-stack development engineer with demonstrated ownership of software design, implementation, debugging, and maintenance.
Experience investigating and troubleshooting complex software and protocol issues across multiple layers of the wireless stack.
Strong root-cause analysis and debugging skills using logs, traces, packet captures, signaling analysis, performance metrics, and software debugging tools.
Familiarity with 3GPP specifications and wireless protocol implementation.
Strong understanding of software architecture and development processes, with the ability to understand, modify, and extend existing codebases.
Experience participating in code reviews and working within collaborative software development environments.
Ability to design, develop, test, and deliver production-quality software.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate combines deep wireless protocol expertise with strong hands-on software development skills and a demonstrated ability to design, implement, debug, and enhance production software systems. They enjoy solving difficult technical problems, working directly with cutting-edge customers, and collaborating with R&D teams to deliver innovative solutions. This role is best suited for engineers with strong software development and protocol-stack implementation experience who enjoy combining product development with customer-facing technical problem solving.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modem software, protocol stack development, wireless infrastructure, device testing, or network simulation platforms.
Experience with embedded software, real-time systems, or firmware development.
Experience developing software tools, automation frameworks, and APIs.
Knowledge of wireless test and measurement systems.
Experience working directly with customers on complex technical projects.
Experience leading technical investigations and cross-functional engineering efforts.
Exposure to 5G-Advanced, NTN, Open RAN, or emerging 6G technologies.

Why This Role Stands Out

Develop software that directly impacts next-generation wireless technologies.
Work alongside leading wireless device manufacturers, chipset vendors, and infrastructure providers.
Solve complex protocol and software challenges spanning the full wireless stack.
Influence product direction through direct collaboration with customers and Keysight R&D teams.
Combine deep software engineering with cutting-edge wireless technology innovation.
Own technical problems from investigation through code implementation and deployment.
Help shape future product capabilities by translating real-world customer challenges into software solutions and product enhancements.

Other Information

This position is on-site in San Diego, California

Relocation is available for this position

Travel Requirement:
Up to 50% travel to local client sites. Occasional international travel may also be required.

Skills

The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills; Most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the Salary Range listed below:

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer III
jobs.description:
Job Description

Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc., is a leading defense technology company focused on unmanned systems, satellite communications, cyber security/warfare, microwave electronics, missile defense, training, and combat systems. Our customers include the U.S. federal government, foreign governments, commercial enterprises, and state and local government agencies. At Kratos, we prioritize affordability as a cornerstone of our technology. We leverage proven, cutting-edge methodologies and technology to minimize costs, streamline schedules, and mitigate risks, ensuring timely delivery of cost-effective solutions to market.

Kratos Unmanned Aerial Systems (KUAS), a division of Kratos Defense, is renowned for its expertise in developing, delivering, integrating, and supporting high-performance, cost-effective, jet-powered Unmanned Aerial Systems (Targets and Tactical). As a mid-tier defense contractor, we've demonstrated agility and innovation in providing aircraft to the US military and global allies and partners. Our track record of delivering top-notch jet-powered subscale targets has established us as a go-to defense contractor capable of delivering capabilities at an affordable price.

At KUAS, we prioritize innovation, collaboration, and growth. Our team collaborates to cultivate a supportive and dynamic workplace, fostering creativity and promoting professional development while honoring personal and family lives. Join our team and help shape the future of unmanned technology within the defense industry today!

GENERAL JOB SUMMARY:

Embedded Software Engineers will architect and implement mission-critical software for the next-generation UAV flight computers. They will be the primary link between complex flight algorithms and custom avionics hardware, developing high-performance C++ applications that ensure deterministic control and absolute system reliability. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, they will collaborate with electrical and GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) engineers to design and implement complex physical-digital interactions with MATLAB/Simulink.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Each successive level of Embedded Software Engineer builds on the identified typical job functions listed for the previous level(s)
.

These duties and responsibilities apply to all levels of Embedded Software Engineers.

Designs, develops, and tests C++ flight software and hardware, sensor, and actuator integrations.
Writes software requirements specifications, software test reports, and progress reports.
Designs, implements, tests, and documents software according to KUAS approved processes.
Prepares and presents design review material in support of technical interchange.
Supports flight testing, data reduction, analysis, and reporting.
Participates in software effort planning and estimation activities.

Embedded Software Engineer I

Works under the specific direction and guidance of manager and senior engineers.

Embedded Software Engineer II

Works independently, following general design and implementation guidelines provided by senior engineers and manager.
Mentors Level I Software Engineers.
May be called upon to support business development efforts both in preparation of quotes and proposals as well as sales efforts.
Presents design review and technical interchange material to customers.

Embedded Software Engineer III

May act as the Lead Engineer per procedure for complex projects, as assigned by their Manager.
May drive activities of several suppliers and team partners.
Mentors Level I-II Embedded Software Engineers.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

None

Compensation: $120,000 - $160,000

Experience And Skills

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

Required:

C++ /C programming experience
Demonstrated understanding of Object-Oriented programming principles and RTOS systems.
Demonstrated understanding of software development life-cycle and clearly document software requirements.
Hands on ability to troubleshoot hardware-in-the-loop simulation modelling and make firmware updates
Able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance at the appropriate level (requires U.S. Citizenship).

Preferred:

Aerospace/aviation/UAV software engineering experience
Skills with tools such as Atlassian, MATLAB/Simulink, VxWorks, LabView
Skills implementing interface controls based on MBSE design documentation
Previous familiarity with OMS/UCI, A-GRA, STANAG 4586, DO-178C, AS9100, DoDI 8500.01

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Each successive level of Embedded Software Engineer builds on the identified education and experience qualifications listed for the previous level(s)
.

Required:

Requires BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other Engineering, Mathematics, or Science discipline, with appropriate software coursework and/or experience.

Embedded Software Engineer I

Relevant experience preferred.

Embedded Software Engineer II

Fluency and 3 + years of experience in real-time C and/or C++ software development.

Embedded Software Engineer III

Fluency and 6 + years of experience in real-time C and/or C++ software development.
2+ years of experience directly involved with aerospace/aviation/UAV software activities

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Office and or manufacturing environment.
Roseville, CA (Hyrbrid T/W/TH in office)
Ability to stand and sit for long periods of time.
Ability to perform repetitive motion (keyboarding, 10-key, phones).
May work extended hours or weekends.
May be required to lift up to 50 pounds in accordance with KUAS General Safety Training guidelines.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.description:
Job Description

Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc., is a leading defense technology company focused on unmanned systems, satellite communications, cyber security/warfare, microwave electronics, missile defense, training, and combat systems. Our customers include the U.S. federal government, foreign governments, commercial enterprises, and state and local government agencies. At Kratos, we prioritize affordability as a cornerstone of our technology. We leverage proven, cutting-edge methodologies and technology to minimize costs, streamline schedules, and mitigate risks, ensuring timely delivery of cost-effective solutions to market.

Kratos Unmanned Aerial Systems (KUAS), a division of Kratos Defense, is renowned for its expertise in developing, delivering, integrating, and supporting high-performance, cost-effective, jet-powered Unmanned Aerial Systems (Targets and Tactical). As a mid-tier defense contractor, we've demonstrated agility and innovation in providing aircraft to the US military and global allies and partners. Our track record of delivering top-notch jet-powered subscale targets has established us as a go-to defense contractor capable of delivering capabilities at an affordable price.

At KUAS, we prioritize innovation, collaboration, and growth. Our team collaborates to cultivate a supportive and dynamic workplace, fostering creativity and promoting professional development while honoring personal and family lives. Join our team and help shape the future of unmanned technology within the defense industry today!

GENERAL JOB SUMMARY:

Embedded Software Engineers will architect and implement mission-critical software for the next-generation UAV flight computers. They will be the primary link between complex flight algorithms and custom avionics hardware, developing high-performance C++ applications that ensure deterministic control and absolute system reliability. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, they will collaborate with electrical and GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) engineers to design and implement complex physical-digital interactions with MATLAB/Simulink.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Each successive level of Embedded Software Engineer builds on the identified typical job functions listed for the previous level(s)
.

Writes software requirements specifications, software test reports, and progress reports.
Designs, implements, tests, and documents software according to KUAS approved processes.
Prepares and presents design review material in support of technical interchange.
Supports flight testing, data reduction, analysis, and reporting.
Participates in software effort planning and estimation activities.

Embedded Software Engineer I

Works under the specific direction and guidance of manager and senior engineers.

Embedded Software Engineer II

Works independently, following general design and implementation guidelines provided by senior engineers and manager.
Mentors Level I Software Engineers.
May be called upon to support business development efforts both in preparation of quotes and proposals as well as sales efforts.
Presents design review and technical interchange material to customers.

Embedded Software Engineer III

May act as the Lead Engineer per procedure for complex projects, as assigned by their Manager.
May drive activities of several suppliers and team partners.
Mentors Level I-II Embedded Software Engineers.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

None

Compensation: $120,000 - $160,000

Experience And Skills

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

Required:

C++ /C programming experience
Demonstrated understanding of Object-Oriented programming principles and RTOS systems.
Demonstrated understanding of software development life-cycle and clearly document software requirements.
Hands on ability to troubleshoot hardware-in-the-loop simulation modelling and make firmware updates
Able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance at the appropriate level (requires U.S. Citizenship).

Preferred:

Aerospace/aviation/UAV software engineering experience
Skills with tools such as Atlassian, MATLAB/Simulink, VxWorks, LabView
Skills implementing interface controls based on MBSE design documentation
Previous familiarity with OMS/UCI, A-GRA, STANAG 4586, DO-178C, AS9100, DoDI 8500.01

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Each successive level of Embedded Software Engineer builds on the identified education and experience qualifications listed for the previous level(s)
.

Required:

Requires BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other Engineering, Mathematics, or Science discipline, with appropriate software coursework and/or experience.

Embedded Software Engineer I

Relevant experience preferred.

Embedded Software Engineer II

Fluency and 3 + years of experience in real-time C and/or C++ software development.

Embedded Software Engineer III

Fluency and 6 + years of experience in real-time C and/or C++ software development.
2+ years of experience directly involved with aerospace/aviation/UAV software activities

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Office and or manufacturing environment.
Roseville, CA (Hyrbrid T/W/TH in office)
Ability to stand and sit for long periods of time.
Ability to perform repetitive motion (keyboarding, 10-key, phones).
May work extended hours or weekends.
May be required to lift up to 50 pounds in accordance with KUAS General Safety Training guidelines.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

5-10% May be required between other KUAS locations.

, you’ll design and develop technical architecture components enabling application teams to integrate with zero trust authentication and authorization services. You will work closely with application developers, security architects, and infrastructure teams to build secure-by-design integration patterns and accelerate adoption of zero trust principles across the enterprise.
We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed
with

Conduct code reviews and provide guidance to development teams on secure coding and integration practices.

Minimum 10 years professional experience in software engineering, security engineering, or related roles.

Strong, repeat experience with commercial or open-source identity and access management platforms (e.g., ForgeRock, Okta, Keycloak, Ping Identity).
Strong expertise with fine-grained access control models (entitlements, row-level security, ABAC).
Expert proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Go, Python) for building frameworks and libraries.

jobs.title: 2027 Machine Learning Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

We are seeking a Machine Learning Intern for Summer 2027! This is a paid, in-person, 12-week internship. On Maritime Digital Production, you will apply machine learning to the data that defines and tracks how our maritime vehicles are built: 3D CAD models with embedded manufacturing information, engineering drawings, and production and quality records. You will own a prototype from problem statement to demonstration, working with the engineers who author the models, the developers who build our manufacturing systems, and the technicians who build and inspect our vehicles.

What You’ll Do

Receive problem statements, guidelines, requirements, and reporting milestones
Frame a manufacturing data problem as an ML task, build a labeled dataset from CAD models, drawings, or production records, and define how success will be measured
Train and evaluate models (for example, graph or vision models on 3D geometry and drawings, or language and vision-language models for document understanding) and compare them against simple baselines
Build the pipeline around the model: data extraction, preprocessing, evaluation, and a review step where engineers confirm or correct predictions
Independently perform experiments and trade studies, and generate solutions for approval
Test, verify, and demonstrate your prototype with the engineers who would use it, and document results and limits

Required Qualifications 

Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded Systems/ Firmware
new_jobs.description:
About Rivet

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

As a Software Engineer, Embedded Systems / Firmware, you'll work at the intersection of software and hardware to build and maintain the low-level platform stack that powers Rivet's body-worn and field-deployed devices — including our AR/XR soldier systems, which combine real-time sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, depth sensors) with a display and compute pipeline running on embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments. You'll focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, drivers, and board bring-up that make that pipeline reliable, secure, performant, and power-efficient enough to run all day on a warfighter's body.

You'll work closely with hardware, electrical, and sensor-fusion/AR software engineers to integrate new hardware, debug issues across the full system stack, and deliver platform software/firmware that holds up under the SWaP, thermal, and ruggedization constraints of field-deployed defense hardware. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership over meaningful pieces of the platform.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain system-level software/firmware for power- and thermally-constrained, body-worn embedded devices across embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments, with a focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, and device drivers.
Bring up new hardware and peripherals, working closely with electrical and hardware engineers to debug issues across the hardware/software boundary.
Debug complex issues involving hardware, kernel, drivers, boot processes, power management, memory, and system performance — with power and thermal efficiency treated as first-class constraints given our SWaP requirements.
Develop automated tests for system-level software, including hardware-in-the-loop validation.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform bring-up activities.

Requirements

BS in CS/CE/EE, or equivalent industry experience.
3+ years of experience developing system-level software/firmware for embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
Experience developing embedded software/firmware for ARM-based SoCs, MPUs, or MCUs in systems with multiple interconnected processors.
Experience developing and integrating low-level device drivers, interfacing with custom hardware and peripherals, and bringing up new hardware.
Strong C/C++ programming skills and familiarity with low-level debugging and development tools such as JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
Experience with common hardware interfaces and protocols such as USB, MIPI, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, and PCIe.
Ability to diagnose complex system-level issues using logs, traces, debuggers, and hardware instrumentation.
Familiarity with embedded software test automation and hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) or system integration testing
Comfortable working cross-functionally in a highly collaborative environment with engineers across software, electrical, mechanical, and systems disciplines.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, if required for the role.

Preferred Qualifications

MS in CS/CE/EE, or equivalent industry experience.
Understanding of embedded Linux/RTOS/bare boot processes, device configuration, memory management, and system initialization for embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments across SoC, MPU, and MCU platforms.
Working knowledge of trusted boot chain, secure OTA updates, system integrity, and other platform security mechanisms.
Experience with Yocto, Buildroot, Bazel, Soong, or similar embedded/system build environments.
Experience developing embedded software/firmware for resource-constrained, body-worn, or wearable devices with power, thermal, memory, or compute limitations.
Experience working on safety-critical, high-assurance, defense, aerospace, or other demanding embedded systems.
Experience with camera, display, or sensor pipelines feeding AR/XR or spatial-computing applications.
Active security clearance.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.

The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What We Do

Our Software Engineers are end-to-end owners who will participate in all aspects of designing, building, and delivering data-focused products for our stakeholders. 

At The Trade Desk we believe that each opportunity to engage with all internal and external stakeholders is unique. This means you will have the opportunity, based on your interests and background, to work on large-scale distributed systems coordinating thousands of servers in cloud and physical data centers around the world, petabyte-scale data challenges, machine learning, advanced visualizations, and interactive user interfaces – to name a few.

Our system performs all day, every day serving global traffic. It’s important we focus on quality at scale in an agile environment that is based on collaboration, ownership, and trust. Our software engineering teams fully own their charter to work on long term roadmaps while enhancing existing features or tools and continuously gaining efficiency.

Our system performs all day, every day serving global traffic. It’s important we focus on quality at scale in an agile environment that is based on collaboration, ownership, and trust. Our engineering managers are there to build trust with our talented engineers, to understand their strengths and weaknesses and to ensure they are motivated and productive, all the while having fun and enjoying every day. 

About the Role:

The High-Performance Computing team powers core bidding platform by supplying large amounts of user and graph data, ensuring data availability, freshness and quality.

You will be working on system-level optimization in throughput and network bandwidth as well as applying creative probabilistic algorithms to support future scale of user targeting data. You will be responsible for ensuring health and scalability the user data infrastructure of as our platform evolves.
We expect our engineers to be end-to-end owners. You will participate actively in all aspects of software lifecycle, including research, experimentation, architecture, coding, quality assurance, monitoring, maintenance, continuous optimization and automation.
We have dozens of mission-focused teams working across a wide spectrum of technological challenges. You will have the opportunity, depending on your interests and aptitude, to work on large-scale distributed systems coordinating thousands of servers in cloud and physical data centers around the world, petabyte-scale data challenges, machine learning, advanced visualizations, and interactive user interfaces – to name a few.
Senior Engineers contribute to more than our product – they build up our team. Through a combination of mentoring, technical leadership, and/or direct management of small teams, they make others better and raise the bar for those around them.

We are a global team with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. To complement this team, you will welcome ideas that are different from your own and be well-versed in building from common ground to value, seek out, and foster invisible and visible dimensions of diversity.

Who you are:

Our culture is much deeper than just having fun together (though, we do that well too...). We take pride in our engineers being trust-builders, generous givers, scrappy problem solvers, and gritty pursuers of excellence. You do not have to meet all the requirements below, but we believe that people who meet most of them will have a higher likelihood of succeeding in this role:

Skills and Experience:

The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 6+ years’ professional experience in high impact software development environment
Hands-on experience with a variety of platforms and technologies: .NET Core & C#, Java, Linux, Networking, Streaming Systems, NoSQL databases, Distributed Systems
A candidate with deep expertise at the intersection of distributed system, high-performance computing, math and advertising, ideally someone who has built large-scale distributed systems and understands ads ecosystem.

Understanding of Agile development methodology and development practices.
You have a Bachelor’s/Master’s level degree in a computer-science or relevant engineering related field or equivalent experience.

Not everyone has the same level of access to opportunities. What is most important to us is what and how you can contribute, which is why our consideration is not limited by the level of education you have.

Key Attributes:

You understand engineering fundamentals and think from first principles. At our scale, many off-the-shelf techniques and existing technologies (open source and enterprise) simply don't work. You must evaluate specific solutions for specific problems.
You have proven records of building distributed systems that are always online.
You work with confidence and without ego, hold defensible ideas and advocate for what you believe is right. You are also adept at identifying and evaluating trade-offs, willing to be proven wrong, and support your fellow teammates.
You value, seek out, and foster diversity. We are a global team from many diverse backgrounds, with different experiences and perspectives.
You are a creative thinker, ready to learn and innovate, and not bound by "the way things have always been done".

Variety of technical opportunities is one of the best things about working at The Trade Desk as a software engineer which is why we do not expect you to know every technology we use when you start. What we care about is that you can learn quickly and find solutions to complex problems using the optimum tools for the job. What you know is less important than how well you learn and innovate. new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

The Job

You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.

We hire across levels, from strong early-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship.

You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals.

You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs.
You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast.
You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem.
You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process.

Developer-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale.
Background in security, identity, or permission systems.
Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks.
Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure.

Craftbridge Digital builds web apps, API integrations and automation scripts for businesses, and keeps their older software running. We're based in Austin.

We're hiring a Software Developer. Full-time, remote from anywhere in the United States.

A typical ticket: a client's order form has to push data into their accounting system, and nobody wrote down how the old sync worked.
